scripts.title: Echo Studios
scripts.features:
🎣 Echo Hub Fish It Script — Advanced Fishing Automation Suite

Echo hub,Fish It Script is a full automation framework built for high-efficiency fishing, resource grinding, and quality-of-life optimization. Designed for long runtime sessions, it handles repetitive gameplay loops with precision timing and minimal performance impact.

Features are grouped for clarity and control:

Core Automation

Auto Fish Engine: Intelligent fishing loop with timing detection for consistent catches.

Smart Reel System: Automatically reacts to bite events for optimized success rate.

Auto Sell / Deposit: Moves fish to inventory or sells instantly to maintain farming flow.

Idle Loop Handler: Keeps automation running safely during long AFK sessions.

Session Stabilizer: Prevents desync and loop break during extended runtime.

Resource & Progression

Auto Farm Currency: Continuous money generation through optimized catch cycles.

Auto Upgrade Tools: Applies upgrades when requirements are met.

Auto Equip Best Rod: Detects and switches to highest efficiency gear.

Inventory Manager: Prevents overflow and handles item sorting.

Movement & Utility

Teleport Nodes: Fast travel to fishing zones, shop, vendor, and safe areas.

Speed Control: Adjustable movement modifier for faster farming routes.

No Clip / Fly: Exploration mode for rapid repositioning.

Instant Interact: Removes delays from NPC/shop interactions.

Visual Enhancements

Fish ESP: Highlights catch zones and active fishing spots.

Item ESP: Displays loot, vendors, and interactables through terrain.

Fullbright: Removes darkness/fog for clear visibility.

Zone Scanner: Reveals optimal fishing areas.

Stability & Protection

Anti-AFK: Prevents inactivity kick.

Low Resource Mode: Optimized for weak executors/devices.

Server Sync Protection: Reduces script break during lag spikes.

Clean GUI: Lightweight interface with toggles and sliders.

Fish It Script is engineered for grinders who want predictable automation, stable execution, and maximum efficiency without babysitting the script.

Run it. Farm passively. Let the framework do the work.
